posts.t: Flyers activate Rasmus Ristolainen off injured reserve

Suspect what you'll see with Ristolainen back is Bonk will get his minutes cut a bit -- wouldn't be surprised to see Risto take some shifts with Sanheim, particularly on d-zone starts -- but they clearly (and rightfully) like what the Sanheim-Bonk pair has provided so far.

Based on Tocchet's answer to my question about what happens to Bonk's usage once York & Ristolainen are ready to return, it sounds like:

A) He prob won't stay in the top-pair role, at least from a mins standpoints
B) He's going to stay in the lineup (and on the roster) though
Rasmus Ristolainen and Cam York are on the ice for practice today. Owen Tippett and Travis Konecny, though, are not.
